normal_wall.method: Original outer-surface facet-normal chords on final BODY; omit openings plus 2.4 mm neighbourhood, end rims and side-button transitions. Finite samples, not a global minimum wall proof.

symmetry.excluded_region: Side keys and their internal guide roots: |X|>7, D27..61, Z>5.4 mm; both sides excluded for comparison.

holes.count_note: Counts are cutter profiles, not a claim that all openings remain disconnected; the carrier opening joins the wheel/key installation apertures. Functional mounting regions have wider members.

limits: No stress, fatigue, bending or physical fit verification. Thin intentional spring and countersink features excluded from ordinary shell-wall statistic.
